phase_name: Flakiness Decision Gate -- 3 Repeated Parallel Runs

objectives.description: Run the full suite 3 times at --jobs 4, capturing --timings and pass/fail sets
objectives.note: Completed this dispatch: checked free -h first (swap 15Gi/31Gi, load average ~3.7-4.3 from 5 concurrent claude sessions plus a browser -- elevated but not the ~17-19 GiB extreme of the prior dispatch's second attempt), then ran all 3 full-suite --jobs 4 passes as sequential, foreground, blocking Bash calls (never backgrounded) against the final committed code. All 3 completed cleanly within their own timeouts: 211.9s / 219.3s / 211.9s wall time, 97 discovered suites each. CSVs and logs captured under the scratchpad (phase6/run{1,2,3}.{log,csv}).

objectives.description: Diagnose and fix a real flake found along the way: test-run-all-parallel.sh case3
objectives.note: Carried over from the prior dispatch (committed as 'task 261 phase 6.1'). This dispatch's 3-run batch confirms the relative-ratio redesign did not fully eliminate the flake under sufficiently heavy ambient host load -- see objective 3 and the plan's Reasoned Exclusions table. No further code change made; further threshold-loosening would violate the 'no test may be weakened' constraint.

objectives.description: Diff against Phase 1 baseline, inspect load-sensitive set, apply gate criterion
objectives.note: All 3 runs reproduced the Phase 1 baseline's 4 consistent failures + 1 known-intermittent suite exactly. test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's known drift artifact did NOT recur in any run. Two divergences found, both within the already-named load-sensitive set: test-run-all-parallel.sh failed its own internal case3/case4 relative-timing assertion in ALL 3 runs (no measurable parallel-vs-sequential speedup under current host contention); test-lake-build-guard.sh failed in 1 of 3 runs (its own documented pressured-fixture history). Gate criterion ('3/3 clean AND no load-sensitive suite failed') FAILS. Applied the plan's own no-flip branch: run-all.sh's default job count stays at 1; phase closed COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS with a Reasoned Exclusions table citing the evidence (ps aux showing 5 concurrent claude sessions; free -h showing sustained ~14-15 GiB/31 GiB swap use across all 3 runs; per-run [FAIL]/[PASS] lines for both suites).

approaches_tried.reason: From the prior dispatch: interrupted by the harness's idle-session memory-pressure reap on the 2nd attempt (1/3 runs completed). Superseded this dispatch by sequential foreground/blocking Bash calls per the orchestrator's resolution guidance, which completed all 3 runs cleanly.
